entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It's a desert...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, we see that.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait, what the— Our clothes are still[n]the same?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Futaba herself is asking us to steal her[n]heart. It'd be odd if she saw us as a threat.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If she doesn't see us as an enemy, then[n]your clothes don't change. That's how[n]it works.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But more importantly, I told you to be[n]cautious! Why'd you activate it like that!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Is that why we ended up in a desert?[n]Where's the tomb? It's so damn hot here.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Even though we entered right in front of[n]her room, we didn't end up inside it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: She must really want to keep people[n]away from her.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I see...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What a bleak feeling this place has...[n]It's the complete opposite of Kaneshiro's[n]bank.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's hurry up and get goin'. Where's the[n]Palace?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Is it that way?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh yeah, there's somethin' shiny.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: A tomb in the desert... I see.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Anyway, let's make our way there.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Isn't that kinda far?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Are we gonna walk!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Of course not! My paws will get burned!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I've been waiting for this.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'll make sure to put the AC on full blast!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You're so considerate!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hehe, r-right...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right! Let's roll!
